gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.53358 38.672428)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

),

    ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(h.geom::geometry, 4326), 1000, 'quad_segs=8')) AS clipped_raster
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    hospital_geom h

    ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(h.geom::geometry, 4326), 1000, 'quad_segs=8'))
),
ruggedness_index AS (
  SELECT
    ST_RuggednessIndex(clipped_raster) AS ruggedness
  FROM
    clipped_dem
)
SELECT
  ruggedness
FROM
  ruggedness_index;
